# Knosi

> A self-hostable, AI-native second brain. Capture Claude and ChatGPT
> outputs into searchable, reusable knowledge, then ask AI on top of
> your own corpus. Open source under AGPL-3.0.

Knosi is a personal knowledge management platform built for developers
and AI-heavy knowledge workers. It pairs a Notion-style block editor
with chunk-level hybrid RAG (semantic + keyword + neighborhood
expansion) so the answers you pull out of Claude or ChatGPT become
permanent, searchable knowledge instead of disposable chat history.

The hosted product runs at https://www.knosi.xyz. The same code is
fully self-hostable on a single VPS or k3s cluster — Docker Compose
works out of the box, no feature gating between hosted and self-host.

## What Knosi does

- **Notion-style editor** — Tiptap v3 with code blocks, Mermaid diagrams,
  Excalidraw whiteboards, callouts, toggles, tables, slash commands,
  search & replace, and Markdown paste.
- **Hybrid RAG** — chunk-level semantic + keyword retrieval with
  adjacent-paragraph expansion and clickable source citations.
  Falls back to keyword-only when no embedding provider is configured.
- **Claude Code Daemon** — route Ask AI through your local Claude
  Pro / Max subscription instead of paying for separate API credits.
- **Learning notebooks** — topic-oriented study sessions with
  AI-generated outlines, blind-spot analysis, and review questions.
- **Curriculum map** — `/learn/map` knowledge gap visualization across
  target roles (AI engineer, backend architect) with ~240 seeded topics
  and 4-state mastery tracking.
- **Focus tracker** — desktop Tauri collector pairs with a `/focus`
  web dashboard for app-level time tracking.
- **Portfolio tracker** — positions with Yahoo Finance / CoinGecko
  prices, AI position analysis, and news aggregation.
- **Speak / Words** — shadow-drill modules for English fluency.
- **PWA** — installable web app with full dark mode.

## Tech stack

Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4,
Tiptap v3, tRPC v11, Drizzle ORM on libsql/Turso (SQLite-compatible),
Vercel AI SDK v6, Milvus for vectors, Auth via email/password +
GitHub/Google OAuth + pi-ai (Claude Pro/Max OAuth).
